" (first aired on October 10, 2008), though Rutter retained the record for highest "Jeopardy!" winnings and once again passed Jennings' total after his victory in the 2014 "Jeopardy" Battle of the Decades tournament.

It first aired in September 2006 and the last episode was broadcast on December 4, 2009.  The show was a huge success in the Benelux, despite the show's low budget for the first two seasons.

It is shown Friday evenings on the RTL4 Network in the Netherlands.  The first series of the show aired from October 2006 through to February 2007, while the second series of the show aired from January through to May 2009.  The show is produced by Blue Circle and is currently sponsored by Fiat.  The "X Factor" of the title refers to the undefinable "something" that makes for star quality.
